preconditions.name: null clean (intact_a == intact_b) on every primary (group, seed)
preconditions.note: a failed null makes that seed UNDEFINED; the criterion then cannot reach 6 defined seeds

preconditions.name: every response from the expected brain
preconditions.note: expected `source` = tiny-demo +LTM in every counted arm

preconditions.name: no errored turn and no organ error in any counted arm
preconditions.note: an errored reply or a caught organ exception is an instrument failure, never an effect or a FAIL

preconditions.name: the grounding set (builtin_facts) recorded in every conv/inner counted arm
the corpus-learned production organs had their corpus (data/corpus/tinystories.txt) in every primary arm
preconditions.note: a worktree or pool checkout without the corpus builds a DEGRADED brain; pool_provision.sh syncs it

preconditions.name: every in-process lesion applied (patch called at least once)
the ask group's taught-moat ask-rate defined wherever it decides a correctness session (amendment A4 (a))
preconditions.note: a taught moat whose teach turn was not acquired is UNDEFINED, never novel; with none acquired and every other C3 clause holding, the moat rate decides and does not exist (an acquisition gap, not a curiosity result); if another clause fails, the seed is scored incorrect instead

preconditions.name: every counted arm ran its own registered turn table (amendment A4 review)
preconditions.note: the scorers read by label: a reversed shard in the registered order would pass vacuously

preconditions.name: six seeds defined for every primary criterion

named_gaps: locative frame storage (the teach echo drops the preposition)

why: permuted exposure tracked on 0 of 6 seeds (not exposure-driven)
